set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

parameters.name: radius-server-ip
parameters.explanation: IP address of RADIUS server.

port [parameter2].explanation: Configures the RADIUS server with `[parameter1]` as the server address and `[parameter2]` as the port number for authentication and accounting communication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: Port number for the RADIGUS server.

secret [parameter3].explanation: Configure the IP address, port and shared key of the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: Share key for RADIGUS server.

accounting-port [parameter2].explanation: Configure the billing port for the RADIGUS server.

parameters.name: accounting-port
parameters.explanation: RADIGUS server billing port number.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

parameters.name: authentication-method
parameters.explanation: Authentication methods, such as Radius.

set system accounting events [parameter1.explanation: Configure the accounting events for login sessions.

parameters.name: event-type
parameters.explanation: Types of accounting events, such as login sessions.

set access profile [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order [parameter2].explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.

parameters.name: authentication-method
parameters.explanation: Method of authentication, e.g. none.

accounting order [parameter2].explanation: The command `accounting order [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the sequence in which accounting records are processed, with `[parameter2]` defining the order priority.

parameters.name: accounting-method
parameters.explanation: Fee methods, such as Radius.

set access address-assignment pool [para.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Address allocated pool name.

family inet router [parameter2].explanation: The command `family inet router [parameter2]` configures the IPv4 (inet) address family for a routing protocol instance specified by `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: router-address
parameters.explanation: Default gateway IP address.

family inet dns-server [parameter2].explanation: The command configures a DNS server address for the `inet` address family, specifying the DNS server IP in `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: dns-server
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the DNS server.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

parameters.name: bridge-domain
parameters.explanation: Bridge domain names, such as vlan10.

domain-type [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of bridge area.

parameters.name: domain-type
parameters.explanation: The type of bridge area, like 'bridge'.

vlan-id [parameter2].explanation: Configure the VLAN ID of the bridge domain.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.
